name: Gridline SolarBlock Courier Visor
description: Wraparound visor in matte black recycled polycarbonate with UPF-80 tinted shield, sized to clear standard BCI temple arrays without pressure. Adjustable neoprene strap sits over the head without touching neural port rows at the crown. Sweat-drain grooves channel moisture away from eyes during long outdoor runs.
functionality: UPF-80 UV eye and face shield, BCI-port-clearance fit, sweat-drain strap design.
what_it_says: You're outside all day and you've engineered every discomfort out of it.
story_hooks: The tint on one lens is slightly darker — replaced after something cracked the original.
A small scratch on the inner shield, right at eye level, creates a ghost line across your vision at certain sun angles.
